report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy and contradicts the checkout error-rate/latency alert: error_rate 0.0012, p95 79ms, OK trace, 200 log, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, and no downstream service telemetry is available. Insufficient evidence to bound a root cause; handing off with required observations.
missing_evidence: Gateway telemetry shows healthy state (error_rate 0.0012, p95 79ms, OK traces, 200 logs); need evidence of the actual alerting service and its error/latency metrics.
Need per-service error-rate and latency metrics for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql to locate the fault.
Need traces spanning gateway to downstream services to identify where latency or errors originate.
Need logs from downstream services (order, inventory, payment) showing errors or timeouts.
Need confirmation of which service the alert fired on and the alert threshold/time window.
